answer: The 47.7% statement is a historical absolute-emissions change since 2018 that explicitly includes disposals/divestments. It is not a like-for-like operational improvement estimate. By contrast, portfolio-adjusted intensity is restated to the reporting-year portfolio: emissions of sold sites are removed from earlier years, acquired sites are added to earlier years where data exist, and when pre-acquisition data are unavailable the oldest available year is used to populate missing prior years.

method.acquired_sites: add to previous years if available
method.missing_pre_acquisition_history: use oldest available year to populate missing previous years

evidence.quote: absolute emissions having reduced by 47.7% since 2018 including disposals
where sites have been sold and are no longer in the portfolio, their emissions are removed from previous years
Where new sites are acquired, data for these sites will be added to previous years if available
